slices.title: Loop slices to a ready PR in a worktree
slices.seam: the runner's process boundary, `node scripts/run.mjs` invoked with a feature slug against a target repo

automated: In the sandbox with spec and slices committed, one kick ends with every afk slice's trailer on the slices branch and the PR marked ready
After the run, the main checkout's HEAD is unchanged and `git status --porcelain` there is empty
The runner's own log shows one fresh harness invocation per iteration, each carrying `--permission-mode acceptEdits` and the project's Bash allowlist
The runner never reads harness stdout for state: between iterations it decides from `git log` trailers and slices.json alone

slices.title: Halt on denial or no progress, settle worktree and exit codes
slices.seam: the runner's process boundary, `node scripts/run.mjs` invoked with a feature slug against a target repo

automated: A sandbox run whose session makes a non-allowlisted tool call exits non-zero naming the denial
An iteration that ends with no new slice trailer on the branch exits non-zero as "no progress"
Clean completion removes the worktree, leaves the branch and PR intact, and exits 0
Every halt keeps the worktree in place and exits non-zero

slices.title: Enforce the ceilings and the hitl wait
slices.seam: the runner's process boundary, `node scripts/run.mjs` invoked with a feature slug against a target repo

automated: The same slice id failing twice in a row halts immediately with that slice id named
A single kick never starts a 13th iteration
A sandbox run with a pending hitl slice and nothing else ready halts, keeps the worktree, and names the waiting slice

slices.title: Fire one end-state banner
slices.seam: the runner's process boundary, `node scripts/run.mjs` invoked with a feature slug against a target repo

automated: A clean completion and each halt path each invoke `notify()` exactly once with the end state, proven by a recording osascript stub on PATH
The banner payload carries only the end state name; detail stays in terminal output

slices.title: Resume from git state on re-kick
slices.seam: the runner's process boundary, `node scripts/run.mjs` invoked with a feature slug against a target repo

automated: After a halt and a human fix committed on the slices branch, re-running the same command picks up from git state and completes the remaining slices
No run starts without the command being typed again: a halted run leaves no watcher, timer, or background process

slices.title: Run the pre-steps headlessly and gate on the verify skill
slices.seam: the runner's process boundary, `node scripts/run.mjs` invoked with a feature slug against a target repo

automated: In the sandbox, one command takes a committed decisions.md with no spec through spec, slices, all slices committed with trailers, PR marked ready, worktree removed, exit 0
A missing spec or slices file is written and committed headlessly before the loop starts
With the sandbox's verify skill removed, the runner halts naming make-verify before any harness session starts
manual: One real feature in agents-hq or edm runs end to end where the only human touches are the kick and the PR review
